overview_description.description: Highlight develops a platform for debugging apps and gives full transparency into the errors, interactions, and performance metrics. They believe that by giving people the best tools to solve customer and engineering issues, they can spend more time building their business, and less time searching through logs, manually trying to reproduce errors, and investing too early in their support processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Highlight is an open-source and full-stack monitoring platform.

product.name: Session Replay
product.description: Captures and replays user sessions on web applications to help understand user behavior and debug issues.

product.name: Error Monitoring
product.description: Tracks and notifies about exceptions and errors occurring in web applications across the full stack.

product.name: Logging
product.description: Enables searching, querying, and alerting on logs generated throughout the full-stack web application.

product.name: Traces (Distributed Tracing)
product.description: Provides performance insights and visualization of requests and transactions across distributed web application services.

product.name: Dashboards & APM
product.description: Visualizes and analyzes observability data through customizable dashboards and application performance monitoring tools.

product.name: Self-Hosting Highlight.io
product.description: Allows users to deploy and run the Highlight monitoring platform on their own infrastructure using Docker.
